errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies PHEME and PolitiFact as models. They are the names of the datasets on which the models' performance is being evaluated, as shown by the two separate charts.

errors.text_span: For the PHEME model, bars are colored in shades of red and pink;
errors.evidence: This is an inaccurate description of the colors used in the PHEME chart. The bars are colored in shades of red, orange, yellow, and blue, not just red and pink.

errors.text_span: “w/o text” is a red bar at 88.80, “w/o select” is a pink bar at 87.34, “w/o emotion” is a red bar at 87.17, and “w/o cognition” is a pink bar at 80.10
errors.evidence: The description completely scrambles the values, categories, and colors for the last four bars of the PHEME chart. The correct mappings are: 'w/o text' is 80.10 (pale yellow), 'w/o select' is 88.80 (light blue), 'w/o emotion' is 87.34 (medium blue), and 'w/o cognition' is 87.17 (dark blue).

errors.text_span: For the Politifact model, bars are depicted in shades of blue:
errors.evidence: This is an inaccurate description of the colors used in the PolitiFact chart. The bars are colored in shades of red, orange, yellow, and blue, not just shades of blue.

errors.text_span: “w/o text” is a dark blue bar at 83.02, “w/o select” is a light blue bar at 84.91, “w/o emotion” is a medium blue bar at 87.74, and “w/o cognition” is a light blue bar at 89.62
errors.evidence: The description scrambles the values, categories, and colors for the last four bars of the PolitiFact chart. For example, 'w/o text' has a value of 83.02 but its color is pale yellow, not dark blue. 'w/o select' has a value of 89.62, not 84.91. 'w/o emotion' has a value of 84.91, not 87.74. 'w/o cognition' has a value of 87.74, not 89.62, and its color is dark blue, not light blue.

errors.text_span: The bars are arranged alphabetically by category label.
errors.evidence: The bars are not arranged alphabetically. The order on the x-axis is 'Ours', 'w/o comments', 'w/o text', 'w/o select', 'w/o emotion', 'w/o cognition', which is not alphabetical.
